plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Usage band above the prompt: 5h/7d limits, prompt-cache warm/cold timer, context size, next-message cost per model

plugins.name: cache-alarm
plugins.description: Warns 10 minutes before the prompt cache goes cold

plugins.name: limit-alarm
plugins.description: Pops up when the 5-hour or 7-day limit passes 80% and 95%

plugins.name: push-gate
plugins.description: Blocks git push to main until type-check, tests and the client-script scan pass

plugins.name: deploy-watch
plugins.description: After a push to main, tells you when the new Cloudflare build is live
